🏆 ALL Bench Leaderboard 2026
	

The only AI benchmark dataset covering LLM · VLM · Agent · Image · Video · Music in a single unified file.

  



  
  
  


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

ALL Bench Leaderboard aggregates and cross-verifies benchmark scores for 90+ AI models across 6 modalities. Every numerical score is tagged with a confidence level (cross-verified, single-source, or self-reported) and its original source. The dataset is designed for researchers, developers, and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/youssef3146/ALL-Bench-Leaderboard.
evaluation_method: composite_score (aggregated from original benchmark metrics such as accuracy, F1, BLEU, etc.)
reputation: Community-maintained aggregated leaderboard used for cross-model comparisons across many modalities, but includes mixed-confidence and self-reported entries.
